name: bijux_help
stdout:
Usage: bijux [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Bijux CLI – Lean, plug-in-driven command-line interface.

Options:
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or
                        customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  atlas    Bijux Atlas product runtime commands.
  audit    Audit the current environment for configuration and state issues.
  config   Manage CLI configuration.
  dev      Developer tools and diagnostics.
  docs     (-h, --help) Generate API specifications (OpenAPI-like) for...
  doctor   Run CLI health diagnostics and environment checks.
  help     Show help for any CLI command or subcommand.
  history  Inspect or manage command history.
  memory   Manage CLI memory.
  plugins  Manage Bijux CLI plugins
  repl     Starts an interactive shell with history and tab-completion.
  sleep    Pause execution for a specified duration.
  status   Show the CLI Status (Lean probe).
  version  Show the CLI version.
